question: top 5 open basic categories by count
sql: SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lisbon_places WHERE operating_status = 'open' GROUP BY basic_category ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

question: open high confidence places within 2km of Belém Tower
sql: WITH tower AS (SELECT geometry FROM lisbon_places WHERE names.primary LIKE '%Belém%' LIMIT 1) SELECT lp.id, lp.names.primary, lp.basic_category, ST_Distance_Spheroid(lp.geometry, t.geometry) AS dist_m FROM lisbon_places lp CROSS JOIN tower t WHERE lp.operating_status = 'open' AND lp.confidence > 0.8 AND ST_Distance_Spheroid(lp.geometry, t.geometry) <= 2000

question: permanently closed places confidence bands by taxonomy
sql: SELECT taxonomy.primary AS tax_primary, CASE WHEN confidence >= 0.8 THEN 'high' WHEN confidence >= 0.5 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END AS conf_band, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lisbon_places WHERE operating_status = 'permanently_closed' GROUP BY taxonomy.primary, CASE WHEN confidence >= 0.8 THEN 'high' WHEN confidence >= 0.5 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY tax_primary, conf_band

question: basic categories with at least 10 places having website and phone
sql: SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lisbon_places WHERE cardinality(websites) > 0 AND cardinality(phones) > 0 GROUP BY basic_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY cnt DESC

question: nearest open restaurant to Praça do Comércio
sql: WITH plaza AS (SELECT geometry FROM lisbon_places WHERE names.primary LIKE '%Praça do Comércio%' LIMIT 1) SELECT lp.names.primary, lp.basic_category, ST_Distance_Spheroid(lp.geometry, p.geometry) AS dist_m FROM lisbon_places lp CROSS JOIN plaza p WHERE lp.basic_category = 'restaurant' AND lp.operating_status = 'open' QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ST_Distance_Spheroid(lp.geometry, p.geometry)) = 1

question: top 10 postcodes by historic site count
sql: SELECT addr.postcode, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lisbon_places, UNNEST(addresses) AS addr WHERE taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site' AND addr.postcode IS NOT NULL GROUP BY addr.postcode ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
